## Detailed Service Catalog

### 1. Web & Mobile App Development
- Modern responsive frontends using React 19, Next.js, Vite, and TailwindCSS.
- High-concurrency backends using Node.js, Express, and FastAPI.
- Cross-platform mobile applications using React Native.
- Sub-2.5s Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) performance and zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).

### 2. Custom Software & Enterprise ERP Development
- Multi-branch inventory tracking, purchase order flows, automated invoicing, GST compliance, and role-based access control (RBAC).
- Zero-bloat intuitive UI designed for non-technical operations staff.
- Cloud deployment on AWS with automated backup routines and failover protocols.

### 3. Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines connected to private enterprise knowledge bases.
- Open-weights LLM deployment (Llama 3, Mistral, DeepSeek) with private VPC data isolation.
- Computer vision, OCR, document intelligence, and real-time inference APIs.

### 4. WhatsApp Cloud API Automation
- Official Meta WhatsApp Business API integration eliminating phone ban risks.
- Webhook endpoints handling order tracking, automated OTP verification, catalog browsing, and lead qualification.
- 98% message open rate automation compared to traditional email marketing.

### 5. Research Paper Implementation & Reproduction
- Strict algorithmic translation of peer-reviewed theoretical computer science papers into clean, modular PyTorch/CUDA repositories.
- Reproducibility reports comparing empirical benchmark scores against published results.
- Publication-standard LaTeX, Overleaf, and Mendeley documentation.

### 6. Growth Marketing, SEO & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- Comprehensive technical SEO audits, Core Web Vitals optimization, and structured data engineering.
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and conversational search.
- Conversion rate optimization and multi-channel acquisition funnels.

### 7. UI/UX Product Design & Motion Graphics
- High-fidelity interactive prototypes in Figma following atomic design principles.
- Comprehensive design systems with reusable components and CSS tokens.
- Studio-grade video editing, kinetic typography, and motion design for digital brands.
